profile.ja: 高位のサキュバス。白く透き通る美しい肌、豊満な肉体の妖艶な美女。角や羽根は隠している。知的種族を魅了しその精力を吸う淫らなる種族。魔界では“淫魔の王”の勢力に属する幹部のひとり。
profile.en: She is a high-ranking Succubus, a beautiful and alluring woman with translucent white skin and a voluptuous body, though she hides her horns and wings. As a member of a lewd species that enthralls intelligent beings and drains their energy, she is one of the executives belonging to the forces of the "Lewd King" in the Demon Realm.

text.ja: ククク、私が力を貸すのはおかしいかえ？　なに、あの方が興味を抱かれた、それだけよ。慣れ合うつもりはないが、命には従おう
text.en: Huh, is it strange for me to lend you my power? Well, it's just that you've caught his eye, that's all. I don't plan on getting too cozy with you, but I'll follow your orders.

text.ja: 人間……特に対魔忍とは相容れぬ。ふん、絆され懐く魔の者もおるようだが……嘆かわしい、魔としての矜持を失ったか。私はああはならぬ
text.en: Humans... especially Taimanin, are not exactly compatible with me. Ha, some demons do form bonds with them, but it's pathetic - they've lost their pride as demons. I won't end up like that.

text.ja: 『鹿之助』という名に覚えはないか？　あの方はどうやらその対魔忍とやらにもご興味がある様子。一度会っておかねば
text.en: Don't you remember a name - Uehara Shikanosuke? Apparently, he's interested in that Taimanin as well. You should meet him at least once.

text.ja: 私をこのような傍に置いておいて構わぬのか？　はあ……噂通りの『目抜け』かあるいは底知れぬ大人物か……あの方も見極めようとするわけじゃ
text.en: You're fine with having me by your side like this? Ha... I suppose you're either as careless as the rumors say, or you're a big shot who's hard to read. Either way, I'll be keeping an eye on you.

text.ja: 忌まわしき対魔忍め……特にあの女よ……あの方のご寵愛を私よりも受けるなどとは、腹立たしい……
text.en: Those detestable Taimanin... especially that woman... it's infuriating that she gets to receive his favor more than I do...

text.ja: 人間ごときがあの方の目的を量るなど、おこがましい。己の見える限りでしか判断できぬのだからな
text.en: It's presumptuous of a human like you to think you can understand his goals. You can only judge based on what you can see, after all.

text.ja: ククク……力は貸すが、油断はせぬ方がよいぞ。私が知りえた事は、一つ残らずあの方へとご報告するよう命じられておるのじゃ
text.en: Huh... I'll lend you my power, but don't get too comfortable. I've been ordered to report everything I find out to him, without exception.

text.ja: 安心いたせ、隊に疑念を満たしたりはせぬ。もし寝首を掻くつもりであれば、もう少しうまく取り入る事もできたはずじゃ。そうであろう？
text.en: Don't worry, I won't fill your unit with suspicion. If I had wanted to stab you in the back, I could have gotten in deeper with you by now. Couldn't I?
